issues.legal_issue: A lessee cannot acquire for personal benefit by prescription an easement of way or water flow over other land belonging to the lessor.
material_facts: The claimant held the property under a lease and used adjacent land belonging to the lessor as a passage and for discharging waste water.
The claimant asserted the easement for personal benefit rather than as a right granted with the lease or on behalf of the owner of the leased property.
issues.conclusion: The claimant, as lessee, could not acquire the claimed easement for his own benefit against the lessor.
issues.legal_principle: Section 4 of the Indian Easements Act, 1882 defines an easement as a right for the beneficial enjoyment of land. Under Section 12, an easement may be acquired by the owner of immovable property or, on the owner's behalf, by a person in occupation; a lessee cannot acquire one against the lessor for the lessee's personal benefit. The court relied on Udit Singh v. Kashi Ram, Jevnath Ali v. Allabudin, Basawangudi Narayan Kamthy v. Lingappa Shetty, Abdul Bashid v. B. Baham Saran, Doma v. Ragho, Girdhar Singh v. Gokul, and Gayford v. Moffatt. The court did not decide a tenant's rights concerning light, air, or support for a building on the leasehold.

rule.if: easement_claim_on_appeal and claimant_was_lessee and claimed_way_or_water_easement and servient_land_belonged_to_lessor and claim_was_for_claimants_personal_benefit

predicates.easement_claim_on_appeal: A claimant appealed a decision concerning a claimed easement.
predicates.claimant_was_lessee: The claimant occupied the land as a lessee when the claimed use began.
predicates.claimed_way_or_water_easement: The claimant sought a right of way or a right to discharge water over other land.
predicates.servient_land_belonged_to_lessor: The other land over which the right was claimed belonged to the claimant's lessor.
predicates.claim_was_for_claimants_personal_benefit: The claimant asserted the right for personal benefit, not on behalf of the owner of the occupied land.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns a claimed way or water easement used by a lessee over the lessor's land for the lessee's personal benefit, the rule bars the lessee from acquiring that easement against the lessor.

issues.legal_issue: A person who later becomes the owner of leased land cannot add the period of easement use during the lease to the period of use after becoming owner to establish prescription against the former lessor.
material_facts: The claimant used adjacent land belonging to the lessor as a passage and for discharging waste water while occupying the relevant property as a lessee.
The claimant later purchased the reversion and became the owner, then sought to count the earlier period of use during the lease toward acquisition of the easement by prescription.
issues.conclusion: The claimant could not tack the period of use as a lessee to the period after becoming owner; prescription could begin only when the claimant became owner.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 12 and 15 of the Indian Easements Act, 1882 govern who may acquire an easement and the method of acquisition. Since a lessee cannot acquire an easement against the lessor for the lessee's own benefit under Section 12, the lessee's use during the tenancy cannot be added to the later period of use as owner. The court's reasoning is supported by Udit Singh v. Kashi Ram, Jevnath Ali v. Allabudin, Basawangudi Narayan Kamthy v. Lingappa Shetty, Abdul Bashid v. B. Baham Saran, Doma v. Ragho, Girdhar Singh v. Gokul, and Gayford v. Moffatt.

rule.if: easement_claim_on_appeal and claimant_used_land_during_lease and claimant_later_became_owner and claimed_easement_was_over_former_lessors_land and claimant_sought_to_count_lease_period_toward_prescription

predicates.easement_claim_on_appeal: A claimant appealed a decision concerning a claimed easement.
predicates.claimant_used_land_during_lease: The claimant used another person's land while occupying the relevant property as a lessee.
predicates.claimant_later_became_owner: The claimant later acquired ownership of the property previously held under lease.
predicates.claimed_easement_was_over_former_lessors: The claimant sought an easement over land belonging to the former lessor.
predicates.claimant_sought_to_count_lease_period_to: The claimant sought to include the period of use during the lease in the period relied on to establish prescription.

issues.definition: When a claimant later becomes owner and seeks to establish an easement over the former lessor's land by counting use during the lease, that lease-period use does not count toward prescription.
